comparison.objective: Secure a wheel on an axle with a lynch pin; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Wheel alignment and pin insertion/closure versus hex-key insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, bounded tightening, and repeated dynamic evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Wheel retention by a fitted lynch pin is implied; candidate requires two safe carriage stops and a drift-resistant setting. Retention-force and damage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: The tasks use different retention mechanisms and test different abilities beyond shared insertion.
